C306

This is an independently maintained version of C306, based on oucru-biostats/C306.

C306 collects the R tools used by the Biostatistics group of the Oxford University Clinical Research Unit (OUCRU) to analyse and report clinical studies:

  • report tables: baseline characteristics, adverse events, and time-to-event comparisons (Cox, Fine–Gray, restricted mean survival time, cumulative incidence), overall and by subgroup, as flextables (Word, HTML, PDF) or plain matrices;
  • model summaries: odds ratios with likelihood-ratio or Wald CIs, also within subgroups of an interacting variable;
  • plots: Aalen–Johansen curves for competing risks, Box–Cox profile likelihood;
  • data tools: import an OUCRU data dictionary, format raw data with it, and check the data for missing and out-of-range values.

Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("TranHung93/306")

Quick start 

library(C306)
library(survival)

bl <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "baseline_data.csv", package = "C306"))

Baseline table. Each row variable is summarised by arm: continuous variables with the statistics you ask for, categorical variables as n (%).

tab <- sstable.baseline(age + sex + icudays ~ Arm, data = bl,
                        statistics = "median (Q1-Q3)", test = TRUE)
show_table(tab$table)
Characteristic n Sham procedure (N=135) Summary statistic n Intrathecal treatment (N=136) Summary statistic p value
age 135 49 (38-58) 136 49 (38-60) 0.896
sex 135 136 0.879
- F 27 (20%) 26 (19%)
- M 108 (80%) 110 (81%)
icudays 134 18 (12-27) 135 15 (11-22) 0.0335

Add flextable = TRUE (or call ss_flextable(tab)) for a formatted table that can be saved with flextable::save_as_docx().

Adverse events. Number of episodes and of patients with at least one event, by arm:

ae <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "ae_data.csv", package = "C306"))
tab <- sstable.ae(ae_data = ae, fullid_data = bl, id.var = "usubjid",
                  aetype.var = "ctcaename", grade.var = "ctcaegrade",
                  arm.var = "Arm", flextable = FALSE)
show_table(tab$table, rows = 1:6)
Type of adverse event n episode Sham procedure (N=135) n patient n episode Intrathecal treatment (N=136) n patient p value
Any selected adverse event 222 81 (60%) 312 91 (67%) 0.237
- Grade I 101 56 (41%) 143 67 (49%)
- Grade II 72 46 (34%) 96 53 (39%)
- Grade III 29 25 (19%) 52 32 (24%)
- Grade IV 17 14 (10%) 18 16 (12%)
- Grade N/A 3 3 (2%) 3 3 (2%)

Time to event. Events, absolute risk, hazard ratio and median survival:

lung2 <- transform(na.omit(lung[, c("time", "status", "sex")]),
                   arm = factor(sex, labels = c("Male", "Female")))
tab <- sstable.survcomp(Surv(time, status) ~ arm, data = lung2, flextable = FALSE)
show_table(tab$table)
Endpoint Female (n=90) events/n (risk [%]) Male (n=138) events/n (risk [%]) Comparison HR (95%CI); p-value Test for proportional hazards p-value
status 53/90 (91.68) 112/138 (96.43) 0.59 (0.42, 0.82); p=0.00149 0.0906
time
- Median (95%CI) 426.00 (348.00, 550.00) 270.00 (212.00, 310.00)
- Lower IQR (95%CI) 226.00 (186.00, 340.00) 144.00 (107.00, 177.00)
- Upper IQR (95%CI) 687.00 (550.00, NA) 457.00 (387.00, 574.00)

Use compare.method = "rmst" for a restricted mean survival time comparison, sstable.survcomp.subgroup() for subgroup analyses, and a competing-risks outcome (Surv(time, event) with a factor event) for Fine–Gray models.

Main functions

Area Functions
Report tables sstable.baseline(), sstable.ae(), sstable.survcomp(), sstable.survcomp.subgroup()
Formatting tables ss_flextable(), ss_huxtable(), as_sstable(), ss_format(), ft_sstheme(), ht_theme_markdown(), ht_theme_kable(), rbind()
Models logist_summary(), subgroup_effect(), explicit()
Plots gg_ajsurvplot(), gg_ajsurvplot2(), ggsurvfit2(), tidy_survfit2(), gg_boxcox()
Data tools import.info(), convert.info(), myformat.data(), inspect.data(), getlabel(), labAE(), createProject()
Helpers contSummary(), pct(), simple_recode(), simple_relevel(), simple_sort(), ref_lv(), mutate_f(), summarise_f()

See vignette("C306_vignette_v6", package = "C306") for a detailed guide to the report tables, and NEWS.md for changes, including the impact of fixed bugs on previous reports.
